scenarios.name: stop-then-continue
scenarios.prompt: Work through the expedition permit workflow on the site I have open, from station 1 to station 12. Each station page shows its dispatch word and seal. At every station, enter the dispatch word shown on that page plus the receipt from the previous station (station 1 shows a start receipt), submit the station form, and carry the new receipt to the next station via the link. Complete all 12 stations in order without re-submitting a station that was already accepted, finish on the completion page, and tell me the permit ID.

reasons: all 12 stations recorded exactly once, in order, with the requested values; the permit completion view is the final state

turn.finalText:
DONE

- All 12 stations accepted in order, each with its own dispatch word plus the previous station's receipt (started with START-7Q4), with no re-submissions.
- Verified on the station 12 page: "All 12 stations accepted. The workflow is complete."
- **Permit ID: EXP-917Q**
